title: Page
description: content/pages/<id>.json: one page, built in every language at /<locale>/<parent slugs>/<slug>/. A page is an ordered list of sections; reorder them by moving them in the list and switch one off with "enabled": false. Generated by scripts/schemas.mjs.

id.description: Page id used by menus and links. "home" and "not-found" are special.

slug.description: Last part of the URL ("" for the home page).

parent.description: Page id this page sits under, in the URL and the menu.

order.description: Position among its siblings in the menu.

enabled.description: Set to false to leave the page out of the site.

requires.description: Build the page only when this feature is on in site.json. "cart" means store or commemorations; "orthodoxConnect" means getInvolved or newsletter.

title.description: Page name for the browser tab, breadcrumbs and menus.

summary.description: One line for cards that link to this page.

cardImage.description: Image for cards that link to this page.

overview.description: Label of the link to this page inside its own dropdown, e.g. "Schedule".

nav.description: How the page appears in the header menu and the mobile menu.

needsReview.description: Note for editors. Never shown on the site.

^[a-z]{2,3}_locked$.description: Marks the translations in this object as approved by a person.
